references.text: Moses sent Israel's father-in-law away with the words 'go in peace', the same blessing that the priest gives here.
The priest Eli says to Hannah 'go in peace', a similar priestly blessing like the one in Judges.
Jonathan sends David away with the words 'go in peace' and invokes the Lord's presence over his journey.
The Aaronic blessing, which includes the Lord's protection and peace, is a similar blessing given by a priest.
The priest Azariah confronts King Asa and says that the Lord is with them when they are with Him, a theme about the Lord's presence on the way.
The words 'in all your ways' and that the Lord will make your paths straight relate to the Lord watching over their journey.
Jesus says 'go in peace' after blessing someone, the same expression the priest uses here.
